## Exercise



**Part 1 - Herbarium data**

The first dataset we will work with comes from a herbarium. This dataset is 
provided by GBIF and compiles field observations of several plant species from 
Guatemala.


<br/>

  {{< fa circle-arrow-right >}}&nbsp; With the [`download.file()`](https://rdrr.io/r/utils/download.file.html) 
function, download the **`UC1-3c-open-refine.csv`** file available [here](https://docs.gbif.org/course-data-mobilization/exercise-data/) 

  {{< fa circle-arrow-right >}}&nbsp; Import the dataset in {{< fa brands r-project >}}

  {{< fa circle-arrow-right >}}&nbsp; Extract the binomial names (column `"Full.name"`)

  {{< fa circle-arrow-right >}}&nbsp; How many unique species are there?
  

<br />

. . .


**Part 2 - GBIF occurrence data** 

We want to complete the herbarium occurrences of _Catopsis sessiflora_ and 
_Catopsis nutans_ with extra observations from [GBIF](https://www.gbif.org/). 

<br />

  {{< fa circle-arrow-right >}}&nbsp; Download GBIF occurrences for these two species and only for Guatemala with the [`rgbif::occ_search()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/rgbif/reference/occ_search.html) function

  {{< fa circle-arrow-right >}}&nbsp; Inspect and explore the GBIF dataset.

  {{< fa circle-arrow-right >}}&nbsp; Export this dataset as an Excel spreadsheet with the `writexl::write_xlsx()` function

## Correction

:::: {.columns}

**Part 1 - Herbarium data**

```{r}
#| echo: true
#| eval: false

## File URL & file name ----
base_url <- "https://docs.gbif.org/course-data-mobilization/exercise-data/"
file_name <- "UC1-3c-open-refine.csv"
full_url <- paste0(base_url, file_name)
```

<br/>

```{r}
#| echo: true
#| eval: false

## Download herbarium data file ----
download.file(
  url = full_url,
  destfile = file_name,
  mode = "wb"
)
```

<br/>

```{r}
#| echo: true
#| eval: false

## Import dataset ----
df <- read.csv2(file_name)
```

<br/>


```{r}
#| echo: true
#| eval: false

## Get unique binomial names ----
binomial_names <- unique(df$Full.name)

## Get number of unique species ----
length(binomial_names)
```

:::

::: {.column width=3%}
:::

::: {.column width=42%}
**Part 2 - GBIF occurrence data**

```{r}
#| echo: true
#| eval: false

## Download GBIF occurrences ----
occ <- rgbif::occ_search(
  scientificName = c(
    "Catopsis sessiliflora",
    "Catopsis nutans"
  ),
  fields = c(
    'name',
    'scientificName',
    'decimalLatitude',
    'decimalLongitude',
    'country'
  ),
  country = "GT",
  hasCoordinate = TRUE,
  hasGeospatialIssue = FALSE
)
```

<br>

. . .

```{r}
#| echo: true
#| eval: false

## Append occurrences -----
occ <- rbind(
  occ$`Catopsis sessiliflora`$data,
  occ$`Catopsis nutans`$data
)
```

<br>

. . .

```{r}
#| echo: true
#| eval: false

## Export as an Excel file ----
writexl::write_xlsx(x = occ, path = "gbif_occurrences.xlsx")
```
:::
